import (

func phrasefd1683cb9efb040dcb9ff323bbe5d2d3e9f958d39b3e3e7eafcb136f94b8a9df(state *State, args []string) error {

	stdout, err := cmd.Output()
	if err != nil {
		var exit *exec.ExitError
		if errors.As(err, &exit) {

	if err != nil {

	return nil
